text:
(DAILY MAIL) — Shocking police bodycam footage captured the moment a married teacher realized she was being arrested for the alleged rape of one of her 15-year-old students.
Christina Formella, 30, was arrested earlier this month during a traffic stop after allegedly targeting a young student at Downers Grove South High School in Chicago.
NEW: Police release bodycam footage showing the moment they arrested high school teacher Christina Formella for allegedly r*ping one of her students.
Formella was seen having a meltdown after police made the arrest.
